evidence.AC1: POST /todos {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-14". POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The value is a date only, with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 {"dueDate":"2026-01-05"} returned 200 and set the date. PATCH {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null. A later GET /todos/4 also showed null.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "15.10.2026" and the number 20261015 each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15. I created todos with due dates 2026-10-14 (past), 2026-10-15 (today) and 2026-12-01 (future), one with no due date, and one past-due todo marked done. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the 2026-10-14 todo and, after I gave the no-date todo a past due date, that todo as well. The today, future, no-date and done todos were excluded. The done todo's overdue flag changed from true to false after PATCH done:true.
evidence.AC5: The page snapshot of / showed a <time> element with the due date for each todo that has one: 2026-10-14, 2026-10-15, 2026-12-01 and 2026-01-01. The todo with no due date showed none.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the 'past' todo (due 2026-10-14, not done) had the text 'überfällig'. The today, future, no-date and done-past todos did not.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. I clicked it, and the list then showed only the 'past' todo with 'überfällig'.
